items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had known all them before, like Coleman Hawkins. I used to love Don Byas. I had met all of these guys before I got to New York.

ctx.x: So you’re hitting it with Luis Russell. You’re getting to know all the musicians in New York.
I had known all them before, like Coleman Hawkins. I used to love Don Byas. I had met all of these guys before I got to New York. That’s why I was hanging on 52nd Street.
Are you starting to go to any jam sessions or anything once you hit New York?
